about_item: 【Sofa-Style 3-Sided Bolster Design​】 This orthopedic dog couch bed features a 3-sided raised bolster that supports your pet’s neck, head, and spine—perfect for senior dogs or pups who love to curl up. The wrap-around design creates a cozy, den-like space to help reduce anxiety and promote deeper sleep.

【Extra Thick Orthopedic Support​】 Unlike thin egg-crate foam beds, our XL dog couch bed uses double-shredded memory foam + 2:1 polyester blend​ (twice as thick as standard beds) to evenly distribute weight and relieve joint pressure. Ideal for large breeds (up to 100 lbs) with arthritis, hip dysplasia, or mobility issues.

【Ultra-Soft Rabbit Fur & Quilted Surface​】 The top layer is made of premium rabbit fur and chenille fabric—soft enough for sensitive skin and warm enough for cold nights. A unique quilted pattern adds a stylish touch to your living room, bedroom, or crate.

【Easy-Care Removable Cover​】 The zippered cover is fully machine washable (cold water, gentle cycle) and dryer-safe (low heat). No more struggling with stains or odors—simply unzip, wash, and reassemble in minutes.

【Vacuum-Sealed for Convenient Setup​】 Compressed in a vacuum-sealed—just open, let it expand for 24-48 hours, and it’s ready to use! Available in 4 sizes (L/L+/XL/XL+) to fit all large dog breeds (German Shepherds, Labs, Goldens, etc.).

authors_reviews.text: Dog approved! My dog has never been so happy for a bed before. Just buy this one, it’s such good quality.It’s not one of those egg-crate foam filled pieces of junk. This makes for a really comfortable bed. I wish human beds were this good lol.Anyway just buy this one.
